sentences.text: The petitioner claims that some compensation for the land acquired under the National Highways Act, 1956 has not yet been paid.

If it is so, then the petitioner should approach the competent authority who may verify the facts and do the needful as per law, as, there is an entire mechanism under the said Act for the said purpose.
Let a decision be taken in this regard by the competent authority within a period of two months.
The writ petition is accordingly disposed of.
